text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf got injured during training,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Do not fret so, Trainer-kun.
It is a mere injury. It will heal in no time."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I were to flinch at a minor injury like this,
it would bring shame upon the name of "Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, we could even resume
training tomorrow? Fufu.
choice_data_list: I want you to get some proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oops... I meant to encourage you,
but it seems I only made you look more uneasy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me. I shall keep in mind that putting on
a brave front is not always the right answer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Very well, understood.
In that case—

Symboli Rudolf began walking after saying that,
but suddenly stopped dead in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me, I suppose my self-assessment was naive.
It seems I really ought to rest after all."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I intended to show some dignity,
but this completely ruins it...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
All to be worthy of the "Emperor."
I'll be counting on you starting tomorrow as well, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Body and mind as one.
My heart is ever ablaze to make my ideals a reality.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And the same goes for my body!
I won't fall to my knees over something like this!
